paused.name: SDAK
paused.what: Serverless distributed knowledge base: scrape topics, shrink them to facts through a two-stage filter (regex then a rotating pool of free LLM keys), store the facts across chunk repositories with hash-level dedup, and search them from a static single-page app on Pages.
paused.why: Paused by the owner on 2026-10-23, before any code was written. The spec is sound and it fits the constraints (no server, free Actions minutes, our own free keys), but it needed four corrections first — chiefly that its 'direct web commit loop' stores a GitHub PAT in localStorage, which can write to our repos and must not ship. It is also a large multi-repo build that should not compete with the product line right now.
paused.resume: Say the word. Batch 1 is small and manual-trigger only: controller repo + global-index.json + the Stage 1 regex filter + one data repo. Nothing scheduled starts scraping until that first pass is seen working.
